newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gold price clouds Randfontein's South Reef.
newsitem.headline: Gold price clouds Randfontein's South Reef.

text.p: The deepening of the South Reef shaft at Randfontein Estates had progressed satisfactorily but the company said it was reviewing the project's future profitability due to the current weak gold price and its own available resources.

"Progress on the South Reef project was continuing at satisfactory levels but its future profitability was being re-evaluated in the light of the current gold price and the company's available resources," it said at its first quarter gold results presentation.
The project involves the deepening of the sub-vertical shaft. Work on the 197 level is completed and sinking continues tp 202 level, JCI said.
Totals of 34 metres of shaft sinking ad 435 metres of station development were completed during the quarter.
Randfontein is part of the JCI Ltd stable of gold mines.
